title: Stormwater from a small rainfall event retained on site
text: C1.3.1 Stormwater runoff draining from roofs, driveways, communal streets and other impervious surfaces generated by a small rainfall event to be retained on site, with run-off directed to garden areas, rainwater tanks and infiltration cells (e.g. soakwells), appropriate to climatic, local soil and groundwater conditions. C1.3.2 Notwithstanding C1.3.1, stormwater may be directed to a district or local stormwater drainage system where required by the decision-maker due to climatic, local soil or groundwater conditions.

exceptions.label: C1.3.2 directed to a district or local stormwater drainage system where required by the decision-maker

replaces.note: 'all water' to garden areas, sumps or tanks -> small rainfall event retained on site

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same as the Chapter 2 twin. Runoff from roofs, driveways, communal streets and other impervious surfaces from a small rainfall event retained on site (method and site conditions not tested). C1.3.2 is an exception: connection to a district or local system only where the decision-maker requires it. Renumbered 1.4 -> 1.3; 'sumps' removed.
